Stay At Malting Farm
Welcome to Malting Farm. We’re a small, family run holiday accommodation site nestled into an idyllic corner of North East Essex farmland. Our three luxury cabins, four glamping bell-tents and two treehouses are all individually designed to provide you with a relaxing and comfortable stay.
Perfectly positioned in a secluded meadow on our working family farm, our unique accommodation provides the perfect base from which to explore Essex from. So whether you’re looking for some energy filled adventure or a more relaxing break; there’s something for everyone. We welcome you to discover Essex & Suffolk’s wonderful walks, diverse coastline, award winning food, meandering rivers and historic towns.
Only an hour and a half from London we’re the ideal place to bring family or friends for a short break away from it all. So kick off your shoes and let us welcome you to Malting Farm.

Gallery
What Our Guests Say
A Great Break Away
“
We had such a great time at Malting Farm. Sammy and her family were attentive, welcoming and excellent in every way, really making a difference to our stay. The location, being under 2 hours from London was great. The kids loved the wide expanse of grass area and the zip wire so they really did just run free for hours. Highly recommended for a break away. Thanks to Sammy for a great stay. ”
Karen B. , London
Lovely Location, Great Welcome, Beautiful Scenery
“
Great experience with our 2-year-old. Lots for him to do and animals to see and interact with. Fantastic welcome from the hosts and excellent facilities. Easy access to beaches and Colchester with its castle and outstanding zoo. ”
Ian G , Cambridge
A Fantastic Experience
“
The owners make you feel very welcome and are on hand to help anytime. We had a huge thunder storm our first night and Sammy came and checked we were all ok in the morning. Can t wait to go again to be honest. ”
Lloyd H , London
Great Experience
“
Absolutely lovely week spent here Glamping. Beautiful accommodation, friendly hosts, that are there whenever you need them. Spent time at Frinton on sea, it s likes time stood still, beautiful, and went crabbing at Brightlingsea, great fun. Would highly recommend to anyone. ”
Sarah , Peterborough
A Blissfully Slow-Paced Long Weekend
“
A high quality glamping arrangement with excellent facilities and an honesty shop, all set in a secluded farmland location where children of nearly all ages can be left to roam free and feel refreshingly independent. The owners, Sammy and Will, are extremely friendly in general and helpful for first time visitors. We stayed with three children, ranging from 10 years-old to 6 months! All enjoyed themselves over a three night stay. ”
SarJamesah , Hawkhurst
An Ideal Location
“
The whole thing was very well organised, the range of activities meant that even when it rained we had fun. The field is quite secluded which makes for a peaceful stay, however the location is also really accessible so there are many trips out of the farm that can be made. We didn t get a chance to visit Flatford Mill or Frinton as we enjoyed the accommodation and field so much. ”
Short Stories , London
Fabulous Accommodation On A Stunning Farm
“
We stayed here for a long weekend with four other families at the end of August. We were greeted by the friendly Sammy who was very helpful and welcoming. We had the most fantastic time and would highly recommend it to anyone who is wanting to go. Fabulous. ”
RJFTW01 , Guildford

Luxury Cabins & Glamping Glade Holidays at Malting Farm Our Cabins & Glamping Glade
Stay At Malting Farm
Our small, but perfectly formed site has everything you need to relax. Situated between a wildflower meadow and a lazy stream, our boutique glamping glade and each of our luxury cabins has been specifically created to give you privacy and space.
Our glamping glade and our unique cabins are individually designed to offer you, your very own Malting Farm experience. Named after our native Essex wildlife, birds and flowers; you’ll find the choice between our three luxury cabins and our private glamping glade a difficult one to make.
To make your stay with us that little bit extra special, you’ll find a delicious homemade cake awaiting your arrival. If you have any special requirements during your stay, please get in contact with Sammy or Emma at info@maltingfarm.co.uk .

Treehouse Holidays at Malting Farm, Essex | COMING SOON Our Treehouse
Under Construction
Our gorgeous Oak trees have stood sentinel over our mellow meadow for decades.
Generations of the King’s family have climbed, skinned knees and had epic battles through the trees at Malting Farm. Incorporating their stately charm into our plans has been a challenge; but it’s provided us with the most amazing opportunity to create something unique and special.
Our luxury treehouse surrounds and incorporates two of our wonderful, established oak trees. Sympathetically designed to enhance and protect our trees; we’ve combined natural materials like sedum roofing, with large glass window areas that give you the best leafy views across the meadows.
The treehouse will feature leafy living spaces, a super-king sized bed, star-gazing windows and a private hot tub just outside the main bedroom. The outdoor deck area that surrounds the treehouse, will provide the perfect place to relax and enjoy some magical high-rise living!
Building our three beautiful cabins during Covid has unfortunately put our Treehouse project on hold for the time being. We plan to start building in 2024 so watch this space! Click below to stay up to date with all our treehouse news.

About Us | How Malting Farm Grew with Our Family About Malting Farm
Our Story So Far
Nestled into our 300 acre working farm in Little Bentley, Malting Farm is an idyllic spot to both relax in and explore from. Only an hour and a half from London, we’re the ideal place to bring family and friends for a short break away from it all. Perfectly positioned in an idyllic North East Essex meadow; Our three luxury cabins, four glamping bell-tents and two stylish treehouses are all individually designed to create a comfortable space for you to unwind.
The King family have passionately run the farm since the 1920’s. The four generations that have taken care of this beautiful landscape have seen a huge amount of change. Our farm continues to grow and evolve with us as a family. Our exciting new venture at Malting Farm is part of our long term diversification plans, which are designed to complement our love of farming, family and the countryside.
Malting Farm originally started out in 2012 as a franchise glamping site with six safari tents. But, we always harboured dreams of building our own creative, purpose built accommodation that complemented our unique site. Fast forward a few years, throwing a wedding, some farming fun and two small children into the mix and inspiration hit! We suddenly realised how impossible it is to find a holiday to suit the whole family. So we decided we wanted to provide the kind of holiday experience that we wanted for ourselves. We didn’t want a retreat with nothing to do, but we definitely didn’t want a busy commercial kids holiday either. We wanted nature, outdoor space and a few relaxing nature based activities we could all enjoy. We also wanted the freedom to explore a new area and maybe even try something new.
Malting Farm is purposefully small and private. Our location allows you to discover Essex and Suffolk’s wonderful walks, diverse coastline, award winning food, meandering rivers and historic towns at your own pace. So whether you’re looking for some energy filled adventure or a more relaxing break; there’s something for everyone.
We look forward to welcoming you at Malting Farm
Sammy & Will
Stay In Touch
The Farm
We wouldn’t be farmers if we didn’t want to tell you a little bit about our fabulous farm! Malting Farm is part of our 300 acre working family farm in Little Bentley. Our farm is a mixed farm, which means we produce both arable crops and manage livestock.
Our arable crops include potatoes, wheat, barley, rapeseed, onions, and maize. The farm also has a small herd of cattle and a livery yard for horses. We participate in national environmental schemes. This involves us using arable land to provide things like winter bird food and shelter, leaving grass margins around our arable fields for natural predators and insect life. On top of this we have created a long term hedge and tree planting plan, and to date we have planted an acre of woodland and over 1km of hedges.
As farmers we’re really proud of the conservation projects and the sustainability of our farming practices. The Malting Farm site supports the conservation work that we’re continuing to build on and we’re always looking for innovative ways to improve the way we impact our environment.
